headline: Watch out, Premier League -- Arsenal are still the team to beat
description: Arsenal more than looked the part of reigning champions, strolling past Coventry 3-0 to kick off the Premier League season.

headline: Premier League recap: Arsenal kick off season with win over Coventry
description: The 2026-27 Premier League season kicked off with defending champions Arsenal beating newly promoted Coventry City 3-0 at the Emirates.

headline: Arsenal rout Coventry to start Premier League title defense
description: Arsenal made light work of Premier League newcomers Coventry City as the Gunners began their title defense with a statement 3-0 win at the Emirates Stadium on Friday.
